7.5.8.original_text: ISO 13485 subclause 7.5.8 – Identification sets out the requirements to be able to clearly identify the product and its status throughout production and delivery. This clause is where the requirements for use dates, lot numbers and specific labeling based on regulatory requirements are considered including unique device identifiers (if applicable).
